entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?

Hi Charlie... I'm calling about an order. I feel a bit embarrassed, honestly. I bought a jersey a while back and I just haven't been able to wear it. I was so excited for it, but... I think I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into it for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the sizing. It turned out to be the wrong size, and it's just far too tight on me. I thought maybe I could do an exchange, but it's been a couple of months now. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and with things being tight, I really needed this money back.

I completely understand. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your order history... one moment. Okay, I see the jersey you're referring to. It looks like it was delivered 74 days ago. Let me just confirm our return policy.
Yes, it looks like you're good to go. Our policy allows for returns on standard items within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, are you serious? That's... that's such a huge relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. Thank you so much!

Of course, happy to help. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print that out, package up the jersey, and you can drop it off at any post office. We'll process your full refund once we receive it.
That is fantastic news. You've really made my day, Charlie. Thank you!
You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
